hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | tr ';|&' '\n' | grep -E 'git[[:space:]]+push' | grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])(-f|--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes)([=[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push の force 系オプションは禁止。リモートを巻き戻すおそれがあるため、必要なら人が手で実行する。"}}'; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; command -v git-secrets >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git secrets --scan --cached >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"staged の内容が git-secrets のパターンに一致した。git secrets --scan --cached で確認し、誤検知なら .gitallowed に追加する。"}}'; exit 0

c=" $(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')"; m() { printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq -e "$1"; }; { m 'git[[:space:]]+reset([[:space:]]|$).*--hard' || m 'git[[:space:]]+checkout[[:space:]].*(--|\.)([[:space:]]|$)' || m 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|switch)(.*[[:space:]])?(-f|--force|--discard-changes)([[:space:]]|$)' || m 'git[[:space:]]+clean(.*[[:space:]])?(--force|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*)([[:space:]]|$)' || { m 'git[[:space:]]+restore([[:space:]]|$)' && { ! m '\-\-staged' || m '\-\-worktree'; }; }; } && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"未コミットの変更を捨てる操作。"}}'; exit 0
